limitations: This case uses real observed gauge and rain data, not simulated; there is no camera footage for it.
Facility coordinates are reported locations from ECHO (outfall points where available, otherwise facility geocodes), not surveyed discharge points.
Rain is daily totals only (the event day and the day before); timing within a day is unknown, and a missing day is reported as no rain reading, not zero rain.
Travel times shown with ≥ are lower bounds: some reaches on the path have no EROM velocity, and missing velocities are never filled in.
Conductivity→TDS and turbidity→TSS parameter matches are proxies: indirect indicators, not the same measurement.
No camera footage for this case, so the Roboflow debris model was not run; it detects trash and people, not plumes.
Violations are reported or alleged ECHO records, counted only within the stated window; historical violations are shown separately and not ranked.
TRI is annual self-reported data and cannot confirm a live event.
